does: Removes a mod from the client's mod settings by its UUID (ls::ModuleSettings::RemoveMod), saves modsettings.lsx and re-resolves the load-ordered modules (ecl::ModManagerClient::SaveSettingsAndReload), then calls the manager's enabled-state listeners; the game's mod manager calls it when the player disables a mod

evidence.says: same shape as EoCClient.dll's ecl::ModManagerClient::RemoveMod - the settings' RemoveMod on the manager's settings, SaveSettingsAndReload, then the listeners; gui::DCModBrowser::ToggleModEnabled (bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x15F2290) calls it to disable a mod, as NoesisGameUI.dll's does
EoCClient.dll exports this name; nothing but the name ties it to this function

dx11 pseudo-code: calls code:ls::ModuleSettings::RemoveMod on this+0x1C0 with the mod, then code:ecl::ModManagerClient::SaveSettingsAndReload on this, then each listener of the array at this+0x1F8 (count +0x204, stride 0x48) with the mod

probes in copy coord (c2, build v34-start-extmod-3), Ext.Mod.SetEnabled(AI, false) in the main menu, three times: each call enters code:ls::ModuleSettings::RemoveMod from bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x181B1B1 with this+0x1C0 and the same second argument, then code:ecl::ModManagerClient::SaveSettingsAndReload from bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x181B1B9; client thread
